title: How Much: 死了, 真 / 多…啊, 差不多, 很 + verb, 大家都
description: Extremely (死了), exclamations, about the same (差不多), which verbs take 很, and 都 after 大家 / 很多人.

points.title: Adjective + 死了: extremely (colloquial)
points.summary: Adj + 死了 = 'to death' — an exaggeration for something unpleasant (and sometimes happy): 累死了, 饿死了, 热死了.
points.body:
- 我累**死了**!
- Not ~~累得死~~ or ~~很死~~.

points.title: 真 + adj / 多 + adj + 啊: how …!
points.summary: 真 + adj = really …; 多 + adj + 啊 = how …! (exclamation).
points.body:
- 她**真**漂亮!
- 这里的风景**多**美**啊**!
examples: How beautiful the scenery is here!

points.title: 差不多: about the same, almost
points.summary: 差不多 (chàbuduō) = more or less the same; also 'almost (done / there)'.
points.body:
- 我们两个人**差不多**高.
- **差不多**了，还有五分钟.
examples: The two of us are about the same height.

points.title: 很 + feeling verbs
points.summary: Only verbs of feeling/attitude take 很: 很喜欢, 很想, 很爱, 很希望, 很怕. Action verbs don't: ~~很游泳~~.
points.body:
- 我**很喜欢**游泳.
- ~~我很游泳~~ ✗

points.title: 大家 / 很多人 + 都
points.summary: After words for 'everyone' or 'many people', 都 before the verb is (almost) required.
points.body:
- **大家都**觉得这个办法很好.
- **很多人都**喜欢这个电影.
examples: Everyone thinks this is a good idea.

notes: The pattern is adj + 死了.
questions.translation: I ran ten kilometres today — I'm dead tired!

notes: 死了 is extreme, not 'a little'.
That would be 我不饿了.
怎么美啊 isn't an exclamation of degree.
questions.translation: How beautiful the scenery is here!

notes: 很 and 真 don't stack.

questions.prompt: {我|wǒ}{跟|gēn}{我|wǒ}{弟弟|dìdi}（　）{高|gāo}，{别人|biérén}{常常|chángcháng}{问|wèn}{我们|wǒmen}{谁|shéi}{是|shì}{哥哥|gēge}。
questions.translation: My little brother and I are about the same height — people often ask which of us is older.

questions.prompt:
A：{你|nǐ}{到|dào}{了|le}{吗|ma}？
B：（　）{了|le}，{还有|háiyǒu}{五|wǔ}{分钟|fēnzhōng}。
notes: 不多了 = 'not much left' (of a quantity).
差很多 = 'far from it' — contradicts 五分钟.
questions.translation: A: Are you there yet? B: Almost — five more minutes.

notes: 游泳 is an action — no 很.

questions.explanation: Only feeling verbs take 很: **很喜欢**.
notes: 吃 is an action verb — 很吃 isn't grammatical.
差不多 = 'about the same / almost' — it doesn't sum up 很多人.
questions.translation: Lots of people like this film.

questions.prompt:
Where does **{都|dōu}** go?
［A］{大家|dàjiā}［B］{觉得|juéde}［C］{这个|zhège}{办法|bànfǎ}［D］{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。
notes: 都 refers back to 大家, so it comes after it.
都 must come before the verb 觉得.
都 can't go inside the object.
questions.translation: Everyone thinks this is a good idea.
